title: Section 139 NI Act — Presumption in favour of holder

content.overview: Section 139 raises a rebuttable presumption that the holder of a cheque received it for the discharge, in whole or in part, of any debt or other liability.
content.study: Once the foundational facts of section 138 are shown, the accused must rebut the presumption on a preponderance of probabilities; the complainant need not prove the debt afresh at the threshold. Read with section 138 and with the evidence rules on presumptions. It shifts the evidential burden, not the ultimate burden beyond reasonable doubt for the offence as a whole.
